# PDF libraries

The leave form creates PDFs in the browser. These scripts are stored with the site so student details are not sent to a PDF service.

- html2canvas 1.4.1 — https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas — MIT license
- jsPDF 4.2.1 — https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF — MIT license

Both libraries are loaded only when the user opens a PDF.
